<details class="hub-details">
<summary>Evidence and current knowledge</summary>
## Why does it matter?

Instead of only reading a model&#x27;s name or profile, compare what it actually
answered. A response about the wrong entity may reveal a poor candidate even
when its wording overlaps the request.

## Current bounded answer

Direct lexical response retrieval underperformed; bounded refinement and reference-based paths have separate evidence.

**Confidence:** Low
